slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the demand at each demand point j required to be met exactly (total received equals b_j), or is it allowed to be under-met (total received at most b_j)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be met exactly or can be under-met, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, where total cost equals the sum of all unit transportation costs (production-to-station plus station-to-demand) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included both transportation and fixed costs, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0 hidden slots were resolved by turn 3, but the agent continued asking many repetitive and low-value questions through turn 30 without reaching READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent successfully recovered both P0 hidden slots early, but then engaged in excessive repetitive questioning that added little value and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
